summary: Four determinate progress bars at 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent, each with a percent label.
use: Showing known completion, such as quota used or onboarding steps done.
spec: `{#each [25, 50, 75, 100] as v}` renders one row per value
`<Progress value={v} label="{v} percent" />` gives each bar an accessible label
